newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: GROLSCH SEES DIVIDEND MAINTAINED IN 97.
newsitem.headline: GROLSCH SEES DIVIDEND MAINTAINED IN 97.

text.p: Brewer Grolsch NV said on Wednesday it anticipated it would be able to maintain its dividend for 1997 at the 1.48 guilders per share it posted for 1996 and year before.
"I would be very surprised if we could not maintain that in 1997," chairman Paul Snoep told a results news conference.
Earlier Grolsch announced a meagre 1.8 percent rise in 1996 net profit to 59.9 million guilders and announced a 1.48 guilder per share dividend.

Grolsch in a statement with results said it did not see 1997's net profit matching that of 1996 because, among other reasons, last year's results had been swollen by a six million guilder incidental gain.

Snoep told reporters that taking out incidental gains 1997 profit would show a rise. "I expect that 1997 profit compared with 1996, if you strip out incidentals, will show a rising trend," said Snoep.
